title: Strawberry Protein Splash
prompt:
Create a premium cinematic 3D product advertisement for a strawberry-flavored protein powder jar. Place a matte black cylindrical protein tub at the center of the frame, standing upright and partially emerging from a large glossy splash of strawberry milk. The splash should rise dramatically behind and around the product like a crown-shaped wave, with thick creamy liquid curves, suspended droplets, and realistic fluid motion.

The product jar should look bold, modern, and athletic. Use a clean matte-black container with subtle soft reflections, a ribbed black screw-top lid, and large readable front branding that says "STRAWBERRY ALL IN ONE" in bold uppercase letters. The typography should be strong, blocky, and commercial, with light pink or white lettering to contrast against the black packaging. Add small product details, nutrition-style microtext, and minimal decorative dots or splash graphics on the label to make the packaging feel authentic and premium.

The environment should be a soft pastel pink studio backdrop with smooth gradients and a clean commercial look. Around the jar, show fresh strawberries floating in mid-air: whole strawberries, sliced strawberry halves, and blurred strawberry pieces in the foreground and background. The strawberries should look fresh, juicy, vibrant red, with detailed seeds, green leaves, natural skin texture, and realistic highlights.

The strawberry milk splash should be creamy pale pink, glossy, and thick, with realistic translucency and shine. It should wrap around the bottom of the jar and burst upward behind it, creating a dynamic sense of motion and freshness. Add small droplets and splashes suspended throughout the frame, with some droplets sharp near the product and others softly blurred for depth.

Use dramatic commercial lighting: softbox light from the front-left, subtle rim lighting from the back, and gentle specular highlights on the milk splash, strawberries, and jar edges. The main product should be sharply focused and clearly readable, while foreground strawberries and background splash elements should have a shallow depth-of-field blur.

Composition should be vertical, centered hero product shot, low-angle perspective, premium fitness nutrition commercial, fresh strawberry flavor aesthetic, cinematic realism, glossy liquid splash, floating fruit, high contrast between black packaging and pink milk, ultra-detailed, studio-quality product photography, 8K render, luxury sports nutrition advertisement.

Negative Prompt: Avoid distorted jar shape, unreadable text, fake-looking strawberries, plastic fruit texture, watery splash, messy composition, dull pink colors, overexposed highlights, warped label, blurry main product, cartoon style, extra logos, low-resolution details, flat lighting, cheap CGI, unrealistic liquid physics, or amateur product photography.

prompt:

The cookie should be split into two large halves, suspended dramatically at the center of the frame, with warm melted chocolate stretching and dripping between the broken pieces. The cookie texture should be highly detailed: golden-brown baked edges, soft crumbly interior, visible chocolate chips embedded in the dough, small cracks, rough baked surface, and realistic crumb structure. Add many tiny cookie crumbs, chocolate fragments, and dust particles flying outward around the cookie, frozen in motion to create a satisfying slow-motion break effect.

The background should be a warm golden beige studio backdrop with soft gradient lighting, giving the scene a premium dessert commercial feel. Use shallow depth of field so the cookie halves and melted chocolate are sharp, while some floating crumbs in the foreground and background appear softly blurred.

Lighting should be soft, warm, and appetizing, with gentle highlights on the melted chocolate and subtle shadows on the cookie texture. The scene should feel indulgent, cozy, and cinematic, like a high-end bakery or chocolate dessert advertisement.

Composition should be vertical, close-up macro framing, centered subject, dramatic slow-motion moment, floating crumbs surrounding the cookie, premium food photography, realistic textures, high-speed camera aesthetic, warm tones, ultra-detailed, 8K quality, studio lighting, shallow depth of field.

title: Retro-Futuristic Motorcycle Design Board
prompt:
Create a high-end industrial design concept board of a modern retro-futuristic motorcycle, presented like a professional automotive design exploration sheet.

SUBJECT: A premium naked street motorcycle inspired by modern Suzuki design language, featuring a muscular fuel tank with smooth sculpted surfaces, minimal exposed frame, round LED headlamp with metallic housing, upside-down front forks in gold finish, compact tail section with sharp geometry, clean exhaust system with brushed metal finish, large disc brakes and modern alloy wheels.

COMPOSITION: Main large side-profile motorcycle at the bottom as the hero view, with multiple smaller design explorations around it — alternate front 3/4 views top right, component breakdowns of mirrors, headlamp, exhaust and tank, close-up detail renders, and small reference image callouts. Floating layout where elements feel like a curated design board, not a grid. Include circular badges/logos, small inset image frames, handwritten-style annotations and arrows, and technical sketch overlays in the background.

SKETCH + RENDER STYLE: Hybrid style combining photorealistic rendering for the main bike with industrial design sketch overlays and construction lines. Linework should be thin technical lines, light grey/white construction lines, ellipse guides, perspective grids, wheel geometry, and loose but intentional sketch lines under the render. Rendering should be semi-photorealistic, not fully hyperreal, with soft reflections, controlled highlights, and clean surface transitions with no noise.

COLOR & MATERIALS: Primary palette of metallic silver/matte grey body, warm orange gradient fuel tank as the key highlight, black mechanical components, and gold front suspension forks. Materials include brushed aluminum, matte plastic, gloss painted surfaces, and subtle rubber textures on tires and grips. Accent with small yellow/orange highlight circles for annotations and minimal branding text such as "SUZUKI" on the tank.

LIGHTING: Soft studio lighting, neutral grey background, gentle shadows under the bike, slight reflective grounding.

BACKGROUND & OVERLAY: Faint blueprint-style sketch of the motorcycle in the background, technical drafting lines, wheel circles, frame geometry, kept at low opacity so it doesn't overpower the render.

FORM LANGUAGE: Clean industrial surfaces, balanced mix of retro and modern, slightly aggressive stance, compact proportions.

DETAILING: Include exploded mini component sketches, mirror design iterations, exhaust detail study, headlamp variations, and subtle scribble annotations that are illegible but realistic.

OUTPUT QUALITY: Ultra high resolution, Behance-level automotive design presentation, clean premium professional aesthetic, balanced between concept sketch and final render.

Style summary: Premium industrial design board combining photoreal motorcycle rendering with technical sketch overlays, component explorations, and clean studio presentation.

Negative Prompt: No cartoon style, no messy sketching, no exaggerated proportions, no heavy shadows or dramatic lighting, no cluttered composition.

title: Artist's Desk Sketchbook Portrait
prompt:

On the open page in the center, there is a detailed watercolor-style painting of the person from the provided image, illustrated in soft, expressive brushstrokes that capture their likeness naturally.

title: Golden Hour Temple Portrait
prompt:
A stunning portrait of the woman from the attached image sitting gracefully on the steps of a traditional sandstone temple during golden hour. The warm evening sunlight softly illuminates her face and the folds of her saree, creating a serene, cinematic atmosphere. She is dressed in a white saree with a subtle golden border, paired with green bangles, anklets, and traditional jhumka earrings, blending elegance with cultural authenticity.

Her posture is relaxed yet poised, sitting sideways on the stone steps, with one leg bent and the other stretched forward. She rests her arms gently on her knee while gazing slightly toward the camera with a calm and contemplative expression. Her hair is loose and softly tousled by the breeze, catching the warm light.

The background shows intricately carved temple architecture with arched columns and domes, bathed in golden sunlight and partially blurred to draw focus to her. The atmosphere feels peaceful and nostalgic, evoking the essence of timeless Indian tradition amidst a spiritual setting.

Style: Warm, cinematic photography with soft golden hues and diffused backlighting. High dynamic range with gentle bokeh, enhancing the subject's depth and emotion. The color palette includes cream, gold, green, and warm brown tones.

Camera Settings: 85mm f/1.8 portrait lens. Lighting: Natural sunset light, soft flare from behind. Angle: Slightly low angle to enhance elegance and depth. Mood: Calm, spiritual, and warm.
